messages:
Ethan: Quick shoutout — massive thanks to @Nia for stepping in to run onboarding this morning and turning the FigJam into a cookie-fueled treasure hunt :cookie:
Nia: Happy to! The new folks were great. Special thanks to @Carlos for bringing the sticker stash and to @Jem for the lightning demo pointers.
Carlos: Stickers for everyone! Also shoutout to the unnoticed hero who restocked the tea bags last night. 
Jem: Found the mystery HDMI behind the oat milk while hunting for mugs  lol. Small wins. Also huge props to @Ethan for organizing the five-minute whiteboard sprint before standup 9; it actually saved us 20 minutes later.
Ethan: Teamwork. Tiny admin note: I updated the pantry rota sheet and added a "mug audit" column. Please mark if your mug is getting lonely. :mug:
ops-bot: Reminder created: pantry-cleanup rota — first slot assigned to Ethan, Nia on 2026-04-12 10:00 UTC. Auto-note: no pages. :white_check_mark:
Nia: Treats for the rota winners? I say hot chocolate at the next retro. Vote with emoji: :hot_chocolate: = yes, :thumbsup: = maybe, :sparkles: = I bring marshmallows.
Carlos: :hot_chocolate:
Jem: :sparkles:
Ethan: :hot_chocolate: count me in. Thanks everyone for the tiny heroic stuff today 9; it really keeps things sane. :heartpulse:
